svg.title: Figure 5-1: misuse matrix
svg.desc: A two-by-three grid with likelihood low, medium and high across and consequence serious or slight down; the high-likelihood serious cell is outlined red and lists the five misuses that fall in it; the medium-likelihood serious and high-likelihood slight cells are amber; the rest grey.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 5-1 Reasonably foreseeable misuse by likelihood and consequence

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each cell lists the misuses of §5 that fall in it. The high-likelihood, serious cell is the one information for use alone cannot carry.
